rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH eu_territorial_units_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    geocode_regions,
    description,
    geocode_level,
    nuts_version
  FROM eu_territorial_units
)
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.acronym,
  i.short_name,
  i.country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3,
  -- institutions table has no region_name column; use the territorial unit description instead
  e.description AS region_name,
  e.description AS region_description,
  e.geocode_level,
  e.nuts_version,
  i.website,
  i.grid_id,
  i.wikidata_url,
  i.db_pedia_url,
  i.document_vectors
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN eu_territorial_units_lookup e
  ON i.geocode_regions_3 = e.geocode_regions
WHERE
  COALESCE(e.description, '') = 'Nordjylland'

rows.question: Find projects whose subject area is “Mathematics and Statistics”
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_areas AS (
  SELECT
    code,
    title,
    description
  FROM subject_areas
),
projects_core_metadata AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.ec_call,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.framework_program,
    p.total_cost,
    p.ec_max_contribution
  FROM projects p
),
project_subject_area_links AS (
  SELECT
    psat.project AS project,
    psat.subject_area AS subject_area
  FROM project_subject_areas psat
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.project_unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM project_subject_area_links pas
JOIN subject_areas sa ON pas.subject_area = sa.code
JOIN projects_core_metadata p ON p.project_unics_id = pas.project
WHERE sa.title = 'Mathematics and Statistics'

rows.question: Find the id of projects with at least 100 members
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_member_distinct_counts AS (
  SELECT
    project AS project,
    COUNT(DISTINCT unics_id) AS distinct_member_count
  FROM
    project_members
  WHERE
    project IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    project
)
SELECT
  project AS project_id,
  distinct_member_count AS member_count
FROM
  project_member_distinct_counts
WHERE
  distinct_member_count >= 100
ORDER BY
  member_count DESC

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH funding_schemes_dim AS (
  SELECT
    fs.code AS code,
    fs.title AS title
  FROM funding_schemes fs
),
projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    ec_call,
    ec_fund_scheme,
    cordis_ref,
    ec_ref,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    start_year,
    end_year,
    homepage,
    total_cost,
    ec_max_contribution,
    framework_program,
    objective,
    principal_investigator
  FROM projects
),
projects_rowlevel_39 AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM
    projects_core p
  WHERE
    -- exclude projects where ec_fund_scheme is NULL or empty
    p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
    AND btrim(p.ec_fund_scheme) <> ''
    -- For canonical cohorts where a scheme is present, keep only rows where the project record itself has a scheme.
    -- (Lifted literal: empty-string check above)
)
SELECT
  f.code,
  f.title,
  COUNT(p.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM projects_rowlevel_39 p
JOIN funding_schemes_dim f
  ON p.ec_fund_scheme = f.code
GROUP BY f.code, f.title
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
projects_rowlevel AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects_core p
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years
FROM (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year,
    (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years,
    MAX(end_year - start_year) OVER () AS max_duration
  FROM projects_rowlevel
  WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND end_year IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE duration_years = max_duration
ORDER BY duration_years DESC, unics_id
